sloka: स लक्ष्मणश्चाशु शरान् शिताग्रान् महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगान् ।सन्धाय चापे ज्वलनप्रकाशान् ससर्ज रक्षोधिपतेर्वधाय ।। ६.५९.१०३ ।।।।
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇaścāśu śarān śitāgrān mahendravajrāśanitulyavegān ।sandhāya cāpe jvalanaprakāśān sasarja rakṣodhipatervadhāya ।। 6.59.103 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, the enemy of gods seeing all his streams of arrows ineffective, was astonished at Lakshmana's skill, and let go sharp arrows again and again.
